stated_goal: ONLY programs that can actually run on Android ARM64/Bionic, or Android-host JVM Gradle/Maven plugins where a verified Android JVM exists
excludes: x86_64 desktop host binaries, desktop-only sdkmanager/NDK, Termux-only shims without proof inside IDE sandbox, desktop/cloud CI as phone evidence
desktop_routes: legacy and extended/addon registries retained for docs and compatibility, but NOT offered by Android IDE profile

core_android_workflow.name: D8 / R8
core_android_workflow.verification: Preflight is static only; signed assembleRelease + phone regression needed
core_android_workflow.r8_release_enablement: Release Gradle minifyEnabled/isMinifyEnabled true; use existing AGP R8
